objectives: Ensure the safety of the public and responders.
Stop the release at the source and secure Tank 14 and its dike.
Protect the raw water intake and Heron Bay marsh before predicted landfall.
Recover free oil and contain it inside the terminal slip.
Keep the public, the fishing community and the media informed through the Joint Information Center.
fields.commandEmphasis: Landfall at the marsh is predicted for 1420. Boom at the creek mouth is the first priority. No dispersant use until the FOSC and Regional Response Team decide.
fields.situationalAwareness: Estimated release 4,200 barrels of diesel; wind from the southeast at 12 knots, gusting to 20; ebb tide until 1330. Sea state 2 to 3 ft.
fields.safetyPlan: Yes. Located at the Command Post.
fields.preparedBy: Prepared: Planning Section Chief D. Okafor, 0830. Approved: FOSC Lt. Cmdr. R. Alvarez; State OSC K. Brandt; RP Incident Commander J. Whitfield.
